chunks.heading: Is two-factor authentication mandatory?
chunks.text: Two-factor authentication is optional per user by default, unless a household Owner turns on org-wide enforcement in Security Settings.

chunks.heading: Where is my data hosted?
chunks.text: Account and device metadata is hosted on AWS in the us-east-1 region by default. EU data residency is available as an add-on for Pro plans.

chunks.heading: Do you have a bug bounty program?
chunks.text: Yes, Nimbus runs a bug bounty program hosted on HackerOne. Its scope covers app.nimbus.example and the hub's local API only.

chunks.heading: How do I report a security vulnerability?
chunks.text: Email security@nimbus.example. A PGP key for encrypting sensitive reports is published on the security page.
